title.narrative: Urban Environment and Climate Change Adaptation Project

description.narrative: The proposed project will construct and upgrade the infrastructure facilities to improve urban environmental conditions in three coastal cities of Dong Hoi (Quang Binh province), Hoi An (Quang Nam province), and Sam Son (Thanh Hoa province). The improved urban environment is expected to strengthen the municipal financial bases in the project cities through an increase of tax revenues from the appreciation of land values and the tourism industry.

title.narrative: Reports and Recommendations of the President

description.narrative: Greater access to improved urban services in Dong Hoi and Hoi An.
a. Dong Hoi: New urban area in Bao Ninh peninsula developed, serving 2,900 new households Progress/Status: Being evaluated under PCR exercise Data Source: Quang Binh PPC annual report Actual value:

c. Hoi An: 5km of Co Co river dredged, serving at least 2,000 households Progress/Status: The dredging of 5.0km Co Co river will be implemented under Government project for dredging of entire Co Co river (19km) Data Source: Quang Nam PPC annual report Actual value:

d. Hoi An: Damage from coastal flooding reduced by $2 million per year (2009-2013 average: $2.5 million) benefiting 15,600 urban households Progress/Status: Being evaluated under PCR exercise Data Source: Quang Nam PPC annual report Actual value:
e. Hoi An: Cost over revenue ratio of water supply improved to 0.6 (2014 baseline: 0.9) Progress/Status: Being evaluated under PCR exercise Data Source: Quang Nam WSDC annual report Actual value:

b. Dong Hoi: Number of households served by new and improved wastewater collection and treatment increased to 7,000 (2014 baseline: 1,700) Progress/Status: Being evaluated under PCR exercise Data Source: Quang Binh URENCO annual report Actual value:
Output/s as listed by the project staff.

Data Source: Quang Nam PMU construction report

Data Source: Quang Nam PMU construction report

Data Source: Quang Binh URENCO and Quang Nam WSDC training program report

Output: Indicator Indicator: Knowledge and skills of at least 40 PPC staff are strengthened in urban management, environmental protection, and climate change adaptation (at least 30% of participants are women) Achievement: 0 Progress/Status: Over-achieved. 84 PPC staff in Quang Binh and Quang Nam participated in the urban management, environment protection and climate change adaptation, of which 39 staff are female (46%).
Data Source: Quang Binh URENCO and Quang Nam WSDC training program report

Output: Indicator Indicator: 2.2d. 5.0 km of Co Co river dredged and a bridge to connect 2 sides of Co Co river constructed Achievement: 0 Progress/Status: Partly Achieved. Bridge built and put in operations. The dredging of 5.0km Co Co river will be implemented by the Government project
Data Source: Quang Nam PMU construction report
